title: Separated morphisms of arbitrary algebraic stacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use categories fibred in groupoids, functors over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, their $2$-fibre products, representability by algebraic spaces and scheme base-change presentations as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Let $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be such a functor and let $\Delta_f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ be its relative diagonal [def-sfb-dm-stack-morphism-properties]. Define $f$ to be separated if every scheme $T$ and map $h_T\to\mathcal F\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ admit an algebraic-space presentation $Z$ of the $2$-base change of $\Delta_f$, with its specified projection $p:Z\to h_T$, such that $p$ is separated, quasi-compact, locally of finite type on every etale scheme chart, and universally closed. These four algebraic-space-to-scheme predicates are those of [def-sfb-proper-curve-moduli]; universally closed means that every further scheme base change has a closed map on field-valued point spaces. Thus the relative diagonal is proper, with algebraic-space fibres allowed to be nonschematic. No presentation or atlas is chosen by this predicate.
